conbody.p: Add task makes a card in the board's To Do column and places it on the plan, with a start and a due date if you give them.

To move a task, drag its bar. To change one date, drag that end of the bar. Both move in whole days. To place a task that has no dates, choose + Schedule in its row: it gets a week from today, which you then drag to where it belongs.
Select a task to open it beside the chart. There you can:

ul.li: set or clear its Start and Due dates. The due date is the card's own, so the board shows the same day;
make it a sub-task of another task, or a top-level task again;
set its relationships to the tasks that drive it;

conbody.p: Sub-task of and the task chooser under Relationships are searchable: open one and type part of a task's name or its outline number to narrow a long plan to the task you want.
A task cannot start after it is due, or be a sub-task of one of its own sub-tasks.
